2609.21296.title: FairLMs: A Turnkey Library for Fairness in Language Models
2609.21296.paper_summary: Fairness research on language models involves measuring bias, applying mitigation methods, and examining the evidence on which an evaluation rests. Existing tools offer complementary functionality through different interfaces, so combining them requires reconciling model interfaces, evidence formats, access constraints, and result types before applicability can be checked or methods compared. We introduce \textbf{FairLMs}, a Python library that connects these activities through explicit declarations of model capabilities and input requirements. It provides 33 intrinsic and extrinsic metrics, 14 mitigation components spanning four intervention categories, 14 dataset and scoring-instrument diagnostics, adapters for the three Transformer architectures and supported hosted completion APIs, and benchmark loaders. Declarations are checked before execution and results carry the configuration under which they were obtained, so that compatible components can be combined, methods compared under a common protocol, and workflows extended to new models and datasets. The source code is available at: https://github.com/FairLMs/FairLMs.
2609.21296.paper_summary_zh: 公平性研究在語言模型上涉及測量偏見、應用緩解方法以及檢查評估所依據的證據。現有工具通過不同的介面提供互補功能，因此在檢查適用性或比較方法之前，結合它們需要調和模型介面、證據格式、訪問限制和結果類型。我們介紹了 \textbf{FairLMs}，這是一個 Python 庫，通過明確的模型能力和輸入要求的聲明來連接這些活動。它提供 33 種內在和外在的指標、跨越四個干預類別的 14 種緩解組件、14 種數據集和評分工具診斷、三種 Transformer 架構的適配器以及支持的託管完成 API 和基準加載器。在執行之前會檢查聲明，結果攜帶獲得它們的配置，以便兼容的組件可以結合、方法可以在共同的協議下比較，並且工作流程可以擴展到新的模型和數據集。源代碼可在以下網址獲得：https://github.com/FairLMs/FairLMs。
